input.description: A N-D `Tensor` with shape `input_shape = [batch] + spatial_shape + remaining_shape`, where `spatial_shape` has M dimensions.
constraints: The input tensor must be of any data type.

block_shape.description: A 1-D `Tensor` with shape [M]. Must be one of the following types: `int32`, `int64`. All values must be >= 1. For backwards compatibility with TF 1.0, this parameter may be an int, in which case it is converted to `numpy.array([block_shape, block_shape], dtype=numpy.int64)`.
constraints: The block shape is a tuple of integers that defines the size of each block in the output tensor.
If block_shape and crops are provided, the number of blocks in the output tensor must be equal to the number of elements in crops.

crops.description: A 2-D `Tensor` with shape `[M, 2]`. Must be one of the following types: `int32`, `int64`. All values must be >= 0. `crops[i] = [crop_start, crop_end]` specifies the amount to crop from input dimension `i + 1`, which corresponds to spatial dimension `i`. It is required that `crop_start[i] + crop_end[i] <= block_shape[i] * input_shape[i + 1]`. This operation is equivalent to the following steps: 1. Reshape `input` to `reshaped` of shape: [block_shape[0], ..., block_shape[M-1], batch / prod(block_shape), input_shape[1], ..., input_shape[N-1]] 2. Permute dimensions of `reshaped` to produce `permuted` of shape [batch / prod(block_shape), input_shape[1], block_shape[0], ..., input_shape[M], block_shape[M-1], input_shape[M+1], ..., input_shape[N-1]] 3. Reshape `permuted` to produce `reshaped_permuted` of shape [batch / prod(block_shape), input_shape[1] * block_shape[0], ..., input_shape[M] * block_shape[M-1], input_shape[M+1], ..., input_shape[N-1]] 4. Crop the start and end of dimensions `[1, ..., M]` of `reshaped_permuted` according to `crops` to produce the output of shape: [batch / prod(block_shape), input_shape[1] * block_shape[0] - crops[0,0] - crops[0,1], ..., input_shape[M] * block_shape[M-1] - crops[M-1,0] - crops[M-1,1], input_shape[M+1], ..., input_shape[N-1]]
constraints: The crops list contains tuples of two integers each.
Each integer in the tuple represents the number of elements at the beginning and end of a block to be excluded from the output tensor.
crops must be one of int32, int64, i, reshaped, permuted, reshaped_permuted
If block_shape and crops are provided, the number of blocks in the output tensor must be equal to the number of elements in crops.

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `input`.

constraints: If block_shape and crops are provided, the number of blocks in the output tensor must be equal to the number of elements in crops.
